newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up five cents to 14.75 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up five cents to 14.75 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose five cents to 14.75 ringgit ($5.89) a kg on short-covering, amid a steady overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"There was strong buying at the start as players continued to do short-covering after the steady LME," said a dealer. The LME closed unchanged on Thursday.

Initial bids totalled 98 tonnes against offers of 79, said dealers. Turnover was at 94 tonnes, compared to 102 on Thursday. Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia. The local premium against the LME rose to $65 from $45.
